reported.title: Injector pulse is 2000 ms instead of 800 ms
reported.description: PULSE_MS is defined as 2000 on line 7, but the spec requires an 800 ms pulse. The pulse-end check on line 79 uses this constant, so every pulse runs 2000 ms; measured evidence shows pulses such as "pulse from 224 ms lasted 2000 ms, expected 800 ± 150 ms" across all scenarios. The retrigger-ignore logic on line 69 is correct, but the wrong duration constant makes the core timed-pulse function wrong. 5 of 5 pulse(s) had the wrong length: pulse from 224 ms lasted 2000 ms, expected 800 ± 150 ms.

judge_input.spec:
- Trigger on D4 with INPUT_PULLUP (active LOW); mist injector on D9; ready lamp on D12.
- A settled press as short as 30 ms starts an 800 ms HIGH pulse on D9 within 120 ms.
- Retriggers during an active pulse are ignored.
- Debounce the trigger with 25 ms of stability.
- Keep D12 HIGH when idle and LOW while the injector pulse is active.
- Print `mist shots=<n> busy=<0|1>` every 450 ms.
